title: Trump Says He Is Canceling Strikes on Iran, Pending a Rapid Deal
summary: President Trump said he agreed to requests from Iran and other Middle Eastern countries to cancel planned attacks, citing what he said was progress in reaching the “perimeters of a deal” with Tehran.
